title: Athena tool manifest (athena-tool.toml)
description: Schema for athena-tool.toml. Validated at contribution time. Phase 1 fields only — target_param (scope-target) is Phase 2.

tool_name.description: FastMCP function name exposed by the tool container.

container.description: Logical container name; the key an operator maps to a URL in deployment config.

port.description: Dev fallback port; production URL is provided by the operator.

params_hint.description: Human hint for filling params. Phase 1 external tools are targetless.

sensitive.description: Catalog-only governance flag: true -> gated/private catalog.
